ios.desc:
Freezy Transcribe: On-Device, AI-Powered Audio to Text

Transform any audio into accurate, searchable text with the power of advanced speech recognition technology. Whether you're transcribing interviews, lectures, podcasts, or live radio streams, Freezy Transcribe makes it effortless and fast with on-device AI-powered transcription.

- RECORD & TRANSCRIBE LIVE
Capture and transcribe audio in real-time with crystal-clear quality. Perfect for meetings, interviews, lectures, and voice memos.

- STREAM & TRANSCRIBE
• Live Radio Stations - Transcribe broadcasts from thousands of stations worldwide
• Podcast Episodes - Search and transcribe your favorite podcast episodes instantly
• Emergency Scanner Feeds - Monitor and transcribe emergency services communications
• Multiple Language Support - Transcribe in dozens of languages and dialects

- SMART FEATURES
• Real-time transcription with live highlighting as audio plays
• Interactive transcript with timestamp navigation - tap any line to jump to that moment
• Advanced audio scrubbing with smooth playback controls
• Intelligent search across all your transcriptions
• Export transcripts as text files or share audio with transcriptions

- PRIVACY FIRST
All transcriptions are processed on-device using Apple Intelligence's advanced Speech Recognition framework. Your audio never leaves your device, ensuring complete privacy and security.

PERFECT FOR:
• Students and researchers
• Journalists and content creators
• Business professionals
• Emergency services monitoring
• Accessibility needs
• Anyone who wants to convert speech to text

Download Freezy Transcribe today and experience the most powerful, privacy-focused audio transcription app on iOS. Turn your iPhone into a professional transcription studio!

quotes.text:
Greetings all,

Wanted to share a new iOS app released today called Freezy Transcribe. It uses iOS 26's new Apple Intelligence frameworks to transcribe MP3s, videos, and microphone recordings. An in-app podcast lookup can transcribe the latest episode of your favorite podcast. You can also connect to a Broadcastify account and transcribe first-responder audio feeds. Would appreciate any feedback!
